command:
set -euo pipefail
echo '=== VISIBLE AVATAR SUBJECT PREFLIGHT ==='
date -Is; hostname; whoami
echo '--- SERVICE ---'
systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-buehne.service || true
systemctl --user show frankenstein-buehne.service -p MainPID -p ActiveEnterTimestamp -p ExecMainStartTimestamp --no-pager || true
echo '--- SOURCE HASHES ---'
sha256sum /home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual/buehne.html /home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual/buehne_daemon.py
echo '--- HTTP ---'
curl -fsS -o /dev/null -w 'HTTP=%{http_code} SIZE=%{size_download} TIME=%{time_total}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8788/ || true
echo '--- PRODUCTION CHROME ---'
pgrep -af 'chrome.*127.0.0.1:8788' || true
P=$(pgrep -fo 'chrome.*127.0.0.1:8788' || true); if [ -n "${P:-}" ]; then tr '\0' ' ' </proc/$P/cmdline; echo; fi
echo '--- REMOTE DEBUG LISTENERS ---'
ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'chrome|:92[0-9][0-9]|:93[0-9][0-9]' || true
echo '--- WINDOWS ---'
DISPLAY=:0 xdotool search --onlyvisible --name 'FranKenstein' getwindowgeometry --shell %@ 2>/dev/null || true
echo '--- MONITORS ---'
DISPLAY=:0 xrandr --listmonitors || true
echo '--- SCRATCH CHROME LEAKS ---'
ps -eo pid,ppid,args | grep -E '[c]hrome.*(eye-scheduler|go-eye|remote-debugging-port=93[0-9][0-9])' || true
echo '=== END PREFLIGHT ==='
